title: Unary witness strings of fixed length
statement: Let $B$ be a language of bit strings and let $n\in\mathbb{N}$. The unary string consisting of $n$ copies of $1$ belongs to the unary witness language of $B$ if and only if $B$ contains a bit string of length $n$.
